component.name: Capriole
component.summary: Edit, sign and fill in PDF files

description.p: Capriole edits PDF files on your computer, with its own PDF engine. Files never leave the device.

ul.li: Pages: reorder, rotate, duplicate, delete, merge and extract
Text: edit lines and whole paragraphs, in the document's own fonts
Images and drawings: move, resize, delete
Annotations, forms, attachments and Factur-X invoices
Digital signatures (PAdES) with a .p12 file or a smart card, with long-term validation

description.p: Free and open source, no account.
